:::{#def-fitting-procedure}
#### Fitting procedure

A **fitting procedure** is a rule $\fitproc$ that,
given any data $\paren{(\predvar_{\iobs}, \outvar_{\iobs})}_{\iobs \in \obsidx}$ and any covariate value $\predvar$,
computes a [prediction](prediction.qmd#def-prediction) of the outcome at $\predvar$:

$$
\paren{\predvar; \paren{(\predvar_{\iobs}, \outvar_{\iobs})}_{\iobs \in \obsidx}}
\mapsto
\fitproc\paren{\predvar; \paren{(\predvar_{\iobs}, \outvar_{\iobs})}_{\iobs \in \obsidx}}.
$$ {#eq-fitting-procedure}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

The rule $\fitproc$ of the [definition of a prediction](prediction.qmd#def-prediction).
@hastie2009elements [sec. 7.2] write the model estimated from a training set as $\hat f$.
:::
